name: Grid Modernization
description: Evaluates the capacity to upgrade transmission, integrate distributed renewables, and eliminate legacy fossil bottlenecks.

name: Water Security
description: Measures municipal and industrial water availability, aquifer sustainability, and desalination capacity for new energy cooling and agriculture.

name: Critical Minerals
description: Assesses domestic geological endowment, mid-stream refining dominance, and supply chain security for battery and grid materials.

name: AI Compute
description: Evaluates physical bandwidth for hyperscale data centers, cooling water access, and regulatory certainty for sovereign AI deployment.

name: Semiconductors
description: Measures advanced node manufacturing capacity, specialized labor availability, and geopolitical supply chain resilience.

name: Net-Zero Mobility
description: Assesses binding statutory mandates for BEV phase-out, charging infrastructure execution, and legacy automotive transition friction.

name: Advanced Manufacturing
description: Evaluates nearshoring velocity, robotics integration, and green industrial CapEx absorption capacity.

name: Aviation & Maritime
description: Measures adoption of sustainable aviation fuels (SAF), green shipping corridors, and port electrification execution.

name: Smart Cities
description: Assesses digital public infrastructure, municipal energy microgrids, and urban climate resilience planning.

name: Labor Transition
description: Evaluates workforce retraining velocity for new energy sectors and social stability against industrial displacement.

name: Carbon Markets
description: Measures the binding legal authority, pricing depth, and enforcement probability of domestic carbon pricing mechanisms.

name: Space Economy
description: Assesses sovereign launch capabilities, orbital debris regulation, and satellite broadband infrastructure execution.

name: Cyber-Physical Security
description: Evaluates grid cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and state-sponsored threat mitigation.

name: Digital Public Infrastructure
description: Measures digital ID adoption, open banking APIs, and frictionless digital governance execution.

name: Food Systems & Agriculture
description: Assesses climate-resilient crop yields, precision agriculture adoption, and agricultural water stress mitigation.

name: Utility-Scale Renewables
description: Evaluates the capacity to deploy solar, wind and geothermal generation at scale: permitting velocity, land access, offtake depth and curtailment management.

name: Nuclear & Clean Firm
description: Assesses licensing, construction record and supply-chain capability to deliver firm low-carbon power: nuclear new-build and life extension, SMRs, and enhanced geothermal.

name: Energy Storage & Flexibility
description: Measures deployment of battery, long-duration and pumped storage plus demand flexibility: revenue mechanisms, duration mix and integration with variable renewables.

name: Hydrogen & Powerfuels
description: Assesses policy, offtake and infrastructure readiness for low-carbon hydrogen, ammonia and e-fuels serving industry, shipping and aviation feedstocks.

name: Buildings & Heat
description: Evaluates retrofit velocity, heat-pump and district-energy deployment, and efficiency-mandate enforcement across the building stock.
